```{r packages, include=FALSE}
library(vcdExtra)
library(afex)
library(bayestestR)
library(emmeans)
library(ggh4x)
library(polypoly)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(janitor)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(memoise)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)
library(scales)
library(brms)
library(tidybayes)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Knitr options
opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  cache = TRUE,
  error = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.retina = 2
)

# Plotting theme
theme_set(
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
)

# MCMC settings (ensure at most 12 cores)
ncores <- min(parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE), 12)
nchains <- 4
options(brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
hmc <- list(
  chains = nchains,
  cores = nchains,
  threads = ncores %/% nchains,
  iter = 3000,
  warmup = 1500,
  refresh = 500,
  adapt_delta = .90,
  max_treedepth = 10
)

# Create directory for intermediate files
dir.create("models", FALSE)

# Automatically save results of waic() with waicm()
waicm <- memoise(waic, cache = cache_filesystem("models"))

# Contrast coding
options(contrasts = c(unordered = "contr.sum", ordered = "contr.poly"))

# Figure stuff
dir.create("figures", FALSE)
Palette <- c("dodgerblue1", "firebrick1", "dodgerblue4", "firebrick4")
```

## Preface

This document contains the analyses supporting "Curiosity: The Effects of Feedback and Confidence on the Desire to Know" (Metcalfe et al.). Data and code: <https://osf.io/akxs4/>

## Experiment 1

```{r e1-process}
dat1 <- read_excel(
  "data/CuriosityPaperAllExperimentData.xlsx", 
  sheet = "Exp1"
) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  transmute(
    subject = factor(subject_number),
    item = factor(item_number),
    confidence = as.numeric(confidence),
    curiosity = as.numeric(curiosity),
    accuracy = factor(accuracy_lenient, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Error", "Correct"))
  )

# Subject-mean centered confidence
dat1 <- dat1 %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate(
    confidence_c = confidence - mean(confidence, na.rm = TRUE),
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create polynomial predictors
dat1 <- dat1 %>%
  poly_add_columns(confidence, degree = 2, prefix = "c", scale_width = 101)

tabyl(dat1, accuracy) %>% 
  kbl(caption = "Experiment 1 accuracy") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
dat1 <- drop_na(dat1, accuracy)
```

### Summary

There were a handful of excluded trials due to incorrect determination of accuracy by program.

```{r e1-exclusions}
dat1 %>%
  summarise(
    subjects = length(unique(subject)),
    items = length(unique(item)),
    design = subjects * items,
    actual = sum(n()),
    errors = sum(accuracy == "Error"),
    excluded_trials = design - actual
  ) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Experiment 1 trials, items, and subjects") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r e1-accuracy}
dat1 %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(p_correct = mean(accuracy == "Correct")) %>%
  summarise(
    `Mean proportion correct` = mean(p_correct),
    `SE proportion correct` = sd(p_correct) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Experiment 1 accuracy") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r e1-data-figure-1, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9, layout = "l-page", fig.cap = "All participants' raw data"}
e1_p1
```

```{r e1-data-figure-2, fig.cap = "Means and 95%CIs for binned confidence. Empty points are individual participants' mean curiosity at each confidence bin."}

  mutate(confidence = cut(confidence, 3)) %>%
  group_by(subject, accuracy, confidence) %>%
  summarise(curiosity = mean(curiosity, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(confidence, curiosity)) +
```

### ANOVA

We first conducted an ANOVA using the subjects' means at each of 3 confidence bins. Note degrees of freedom (subjects are dropped because not everyone has observations in each cell)

```{r e1-anova}
dat1_aov <- dat1 %>%
  drop_na(curiosity) %>% 
  select(subject, confidence, curiosity) %>%
  mutate(conf_bin = cut(confidence, 3)) %>%
  group_by(subject, conf_bin) %>%
  summarise(curiosity = mean(curiosity))

fit_aov <- aov_ez(
  data = dat1_aov,
  id = "subject",
  dv = "curiosity",
  within = "conf_bin"
)
anova(fit_aov, intercept = TRUE) %>%
  kbl(
    digits = c(rep(1, 5), 4),
    caption = "Experiment 1 ANOVA"
  ) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Multilevel model

A multilevel model includes all data and doesn't bin confidence. We fit a model with just a linear effect, and one with an additional quadratic effect.

```{r e1-brm-fit, results="hide"}
hmc$formula <- curiosity ~ c1 + c2 +
  (c1 + c2 | subject) + (1 | item)
hmc$data <- dat1
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp1-a"
fit1.a <- do.call(brm, hmc)

hmc$formula <- curiosity ~ c1 +
  (c1 | subject) + (1 | item)
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp1-b"
fit1.b <- do.call(brm, hmc)
```

Model comparison didn't strongly favor either model.

```{r e1-waic}
waic1 <- waicm(fit1.a, fit1.b)
waic1$diffs %>% 
  kbl(digits = 1, caption = "Experiment 1 model comparison") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Model summary

```{r e1-brm-summary}
describe_posterior(
  fit1.a,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, 
  centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE,
  effects = "fixed", diagnostic = NULL
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .1)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r e1-combo-figure, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5.2}
subplot <- function(plot, n = 6) {
  plot %+%
    filter(plot$data, subject %in% sample(unique(plot$data$subject), n)) +
    facet_wrap("subject", nrow = 3) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
}
set.seed(999)
p1 <- subplot(e1_p1, 9)
p2 <- e1_p2
p3 <- e1_mp1 + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
((p1 / p2) & theme(legend.position = "none") | p3) +
```

## Experiment 2

### Pre-experiment survey

Responses to question "In which scenario would a person be more curious?". 100 people were queried. One person either left the answer empty or quit or had an error.

```{r e2-pre-survey}
read_csv("data/survey-predictions.csv") %>%
  count(curiosity) %>%
  mutate(nn = sum(n), p = percent(n / nn)) %>%
  kbl(
    caption = "Responses to 'In which scenario would a person be more curious?'"
  ) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r e2-process}
dat2 <- read_excel(
  "data/CuriosityPaperAllExperimentData.xlsx", 
  sheet = "Exp2"
) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  transmute(
    subject = factor(subject),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Low", "High")),
    item = factor(question),
    accuracy = factor(accuracy, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Error", "Correct")),
    feedback = factor(condition, levels = c("No feedback", "Feedback")),
    confidence = as.numeric(confidence),
    curiosity = as.numeric(curiosity),
    post_accuracy = as.numeric(post_accuracy)
  )

# Subject-mean centered confidence if needed
dat2 <- dat2 %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate(
    confidence_c = (confidence - mean(confidence, na.rm = TRUE)),
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create polynomial predictors
dat2 <- dat2 %>%
  poly_add_columns(confidence, degree = 2, prefix = "c", scale_width = 101)

tabyl(dat2, accuracy) %>% 
  kbl(caption = "Experiment 2 accuracy") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
dat2 <- drop_na(dat2, accuracy)
```

### Summary

There were a handful of excluded trials due to incorrect determination of accuracy by program.

```{r e2-exclusions}
dat2 %>%
  summarise(
    subjects = length(unique(subject)),
    items = length(unique(item)),
    design = subjects * items,
    actual = sum(n()),
    excluded_trials = design - actual
  ) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Numbers of trials and participants in Experiment 2.") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r e2-accuracy}
dat2 %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(p_correct = mean(accuracy == "Correct")) %>%
  summarise(
    `Mean proportion correct` = mean(p_correct),
    `SE proportion correct` = sd(p_correct) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Summary of performance in Experiment 2.") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### ANOVA

```{r e2-anova}
dat2_aov <- dat2 %>%
  drop_na(curiosity) %>% 
  mutate(conf_bin = cut(confidence, 3)) %>%
  group_by(subject, accuracy, feedback, conf_bin) %>%
  summarise(curiosity = mean(curiosity))

fit_aov <- aov_ez(
  data = dat2_aov,
  id = "subject",
  dv = "curiosity",
  within = c("conf_bin", "accuracy", "feedback")
)
anova(fit_aov, intercept = TRUE) %>%
  kbl(
    digits = c(rep(1, 5), 4),
    caption = "Experiment 2 ANOVA"
  ) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Multilevel model

```{r e2-brm-fit}
hmc$formula <- curiosity ~ (c1 + c2) * accuracy * feedback +
  ((c1 + c2) * accuracy * feedback | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$data <- dat2
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp2-a"
fit2.a <- do.call(brm, hmc)

hmc$formula <- curiosity ~ c1 * accuracy * feedback +
  (c1 * accuracy * feedback | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp2-b"
fit2.b <- do.call(brm, hmc)
```

Model comparison favored the quadratic model

```{r e2-waic}
waic2 <- waicm(fit2.a, fit2.b)
waic2$diffs
```

Model summary

```{r e2-brm-summary}
describe_posterior(
  fit2.a,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean",
  effects = "fixed", diagnostic = NULL, dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Experiment 2 model summary") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Intercepts

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(fit2.a, ~ accuracy + feedback)
describe_posterior(
  emm,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Experiment 2 intercepts") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Linear effect in each cell and differences therein

```{r e2-contrasts-linear}
# Effect in each cell
emm <- emtrends(
  fit2.a,
  var = "c1", by = c("accuracy", "feedback"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -32.9)
)

# Interactions
gather_emmeans_draws(emm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = accuracy, values_from = .value) %>%
  mutate(`Error-Correct` = Error - Correct) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(feedback, Error, Correct, `Error-Correct`) %>%
  pivot_longer(Error:`Error-Correct`, names_to = "accuracy") %>%
  group_by(feedback, accuracy) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ describe_posterior(
      .$value,
      test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
    ) %>% 
      select(-Parameter, -CI)
  ) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2))) %>% 
  mutate(
    String = str_glue("{Mean}, SE = {SD}, 95%CI = [{CI_low}, {CI_high}], pd = {pd}")
  ) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Experiment 2 linear trend contrasts") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)

gather_emmeans_draws(emm) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(accuracy == "Error") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = feedback, values_from = .value) %>%
  mutate(`Feedback-No feedback` = Feedback - `No feedback`) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(accuracy, `No feedback`, Feedback, `Feedback-No feedback`) %>%
  pivot_longer(`No feedback`:`Feedback-No feedback`, names_to = "feedback") %>%
  group_by(feedback, accuracy) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ describe_posterior(
      .$value,
      test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Experiment 2 linear trend contrasts") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Quadratic effect in each cell and differences therein

```{r e2-contrasts-quadratic}
# Effect in each cell
emm <- emtrends(
  fit2.a,
  var = "c2", by = c("accuracy", "feedback"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -32.9)
)

# Interactions
gather_emmeans_draws(emm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = accuracy, values_from = .value) %>%
  mutate(`Error-Correct` = Error - Correct) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(feedback, Error, Correct, `Error-Correct`) %>%
  pivot_longer(Error:`Error-Correct`, names_to = "accuracy") %>%
  group_by(feedback, accuracy) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ describe_posterior(
      .$value,
      test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Experiment 2 quadratic trend contrasts") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)

gather_emmeans_draws(emm) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(accuracy == "Error") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = feedback, values_from = .value) %>%
  mutate(.Interaction = `No feedback` - Feedback) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(accuracy, `No feedback`, Feedback, .Interaction) %>%
  pivot_longer(`No feedback`:.Interaction, names_to = "feedback") %>%
  group_by(feedback, accuracy) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ describe_posterior(
      .$value,
      test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Post hoc tests Feedback

```{r e2-post-hoc}
ats <- distinct(dat2, confidence, c1, c2) %>%
  arrange(c1) %>% 
  filter(confidence %in% c(10, 50, 90)) %>% 
  mutate(across(c1:c2, ~round(.)))
emm1 <- emmeans(
  fit2.a,
  "feedback",
  by = c("c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[1], c2 = ats$c2[1], accuracy = "Error")
)
emm2 <- emmeans(
  fit2.a,
  "feedback",
  by = c("c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[2], c2 = ats$c2[2], accuracy = "Error")
)
emm3 <- emmeans(
  fit2.a,
  "feedback",
  by = c("c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[3], c2 = ats$c2[3], accuracy = "Error")
)

bind_rows(
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm1, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm2, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm3, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  )
) %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .1)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2))) %>% 
  mutate(
    String = str_glue("{Mean}, SE = {SD}, 95%CI = [{CI_low}, {CI_high}], pd = {pd}")
  ) %>% 
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Experiment 2 contrasts") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Posttest

```{r e2-posttest-1}
pt2 <- dat2 %>% 
  filter(feedback == "No feedback", accuracy == "Error")
pt2 <- pt2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(post_accuracy)) %>%
  group_by(subject, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    post_accuracy = mean(post_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
pt2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(group, post_accuracy)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot, col = "blue")
pt2 %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    median_n = median(n),
    post_accuracy_mean = mean(post_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    post_accuracy_SE = sd(post_accuracy, na.rm = T) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
t.test(pt2$post_accuracy ~ pt2$group)
```

## Pilot experiment 2

This one had unbalanced assignment to conditions.

```{r e2b-process}
dat2b <- read_excel(
  "data/CuriosityPaperAllExperimentData.xlsx", 
  sheet = "Exp2_Pilot"
) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(
    feedback = ifelse(condition %in% c("YNF", "YNCF"), 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    subject = factor(subject),
    item = factor(cue),
    accuracy = factor(accuracy_trivia, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Error", "Correct")),
    feedback = factor(feedback, levels = 0:1, labels = c("No feedback", "Feedback")),
    confidence = as.numeric(confidence),
    curiosity = as.numeric(curiosity)
  )

# Subject-mean centered confidence if needed
dat2b <- dat2b %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate(
    confidence_c = (confidence - mean(confidence, na.rm = TRUE)),
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create polynomial predictors
dat2b <- dat2b %>%
  poly_add_columns(confidence, degree = 2, prefix = "c", scale_width = 101)

tabyl(dat2b, accuracy) %>% 
  kbl() %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
dat2b <- drop_na(dat2b, accuracy)
```

### Summary

There were a handful of excluded trials due to incorrect determination of accuracy by program.

```{r e2b-exclusions}
dat2b %>%

  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### ANOVA

```{r e2b-anova}
dat2b_aov <- dat2b %>%
  drop_na(curiosity) %>% 
  mutate(conf_bin = cut(confidence, 3)) %>%
  group_by(subject, accuracy, feedback, conf_bin) %>%
  summarise(curiosity = mean(curiosity))

fit_aov <- aov_ez(
  data = dat2b_aov,
  id = "subject",
  dv = "curiosity",
  within = c("conf_bin", "accuracy", "feedback")
)
anova(fit_aov, intercept = TRUE) %>%

    digits = c(rep(1, 5), 4),

  ) %>%

```

### Multilevel model

```{r e2b-brm-fit}
hmc$formula <- curiosity ~ (c1 + c2) * accuracy * feedback +
  ((c1 + c2) * accuracy * feedback | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$data <- dat2b
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp2b-a"
fit2b.a <- do.call(brm, hmc)

hmc$formula <- curiosity ~ c1 * accuracy * feedback +
  (c1 * accuracy * feedback | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp2b-b"
fit2b.b <- do.call(brm, hmc)
```

Model comparison favored the quadratic model

```{r e2b-waic}
waic2b <- waicm(fit2b.a, fit2b.b)
waic2b$diffs
```

Model summary

```{r e2b-brm-summary}
describe_posterior(
  fit2b.a,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean",
  effects = "fixed", diagnostic = NULL, dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Linear effect in each cell and differences therein

```{r e2b-contrasts}
# Effect in each cell
emm <- emtrends(
  fit2b.a,
  var = "c1", by = c("accuracy", "feedback"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -32.9)
)
describe_posterior(
  emm,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
# Interactions
gather_emmeans_draws(emm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = accuracy, values_from = .value) %>%
  mutate(`Error-Correct` = Error - Correct) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(feedback, Error, Correct, `Error-Correct`) %>%
  pivot_longer(Error:`Error-Correct`, names_to = "accuracy") %>%
  group_by(feedback, accuracy) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ describe_posterior(
      .$value,
      test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)

gather_emmeans_draws(emm) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(accuracy == "Error") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = feedback, values_from = .value) %>%
  mutate(`Feedback-No feedback` = Feedback - `No feedback`) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(accuracy, `No feedback`, Feedback, `Feedback-No feedback`) %>%
  pivot_longer(`No feedback`:`Feedback-No feedback`, names_to = "feedback") %>%
  group_by(feedback, accuracy) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ describe_posterior(
      .$value,
      test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Post hoc test at high confidence

```{r e2b-post-hoc}
ats <- distinct(dat2b, confidence, c1, c2) %>%
  filter(confidence == 90)
emm <- emmeans(
  fit2b.a,
  "accuracy",
  by = c("feedback"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1, c2 = ats$c2)
)
describe_posterior(
  pairs(emm),
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Experiment 3

Surprise is 100-surprised_wrong_rating_response. There were seven trials where accuracy was missing.

```{r e3-data-read}
dat3 <- read_excel(
  "data/CuriosityPaperAllExperimentData.xlsx", 
  sheet = "Exp3"
) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  transmute(
    subject = factor(participant_public_id),
    accuracy = factor(lenient_correct, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Error", "Correct")),
    confidence = as.numeric(confidence_rating_response),
    uncertainty = as.numeric(uncertaintly100_surprise),
    item = factor(qnum)
  )

# Subject-mean centered confidence if needed
dat3 <- dat3 %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%

  ungroup()

# Create polynomial predictors
```

## Experiment 4

```{r e4-data-load}
dat4 <- read_excel(
  "data/CuriosityPaperAllExperimentData.xlsx", 
  sheet = "Exp4"
) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  transmute(
    subject = factor(participant_public_id),
    group = factor(
      group1curious2surprise, 
      levels = c(2, 1), 
      labels = c("Uncertainty", "Curiosity")
    ),
    accuracy = factor(
      lenient_correct, 
      levels = 0:1, 
      labels = c("Error", "Correct")
    ),
    confidence = as.numeric(confidence),
    rating = as.numeric(curiosity_or_surprised_rating),
    item = factor(question)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(rating = if_else(group=="Uncertainty", 100-rating, rating))

# Subject-mean centered confidence if needed
dat4 <- dat4 %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate(
    confidence_c = (confidence - mean(confidence, na.rm = TRUE)),
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create polynomial predictors
dat4 <- dat4 %>%
  poly_add_columns(confidence, degree = 2, prefix = "c", scale_width = 101)

tabyl(dat4, accuracy) %>% 
  kbl() %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
dat4 <- drop_na(dat4, accuracy)
```

### Summary

Allocation

```{r}
dat4 %>% 
  count(group, subject) %>% 
  count(group)
```

Summary of accuracy

```{r e4-accuracy}
dat4 %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(accuracy == "Correct", na.rm = TRUE),
    confidence = mean(confidence, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    m_accuracy = mean(accuracy), sd_accuracy = sd(accuracy),
    m_confidence = mean(confidence), sd_confidence = sd(confidence)
  ) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Gamma correlation confidence - accuracy

```{r e4-gamma}
dat4 %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(
    resolution = GKgamma(table(accuracy, confidence))$gamma
  ) %>%
  summarise(m_resolution = mean(resolution), sd_resolution = sd(resolution)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### ANOVA

Three bins

```{r e4-anova}
dat4_aov <- dat4 %>%
  drop_na(rating) %>% 
  mutate(conf_bin = cut(confidence, 3)) %>%
  group_by(group, subject, accuracy, conf_bin) %>%
  summarise(rating = mean(rating))

fit_aov <- aov_ez(
  data = dat4_aov,
  id = "subject",
  dv = "rating",
  between = "group",
  within = c("conf_bin", "accuracy")
)
anova(fit_aov, intercept = TRUE) %>%
  kbl(
    digits = c(rep(1, 5), 4),
    caption = "Experiment 4 ANOVA"
  ) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Multilevel model

```{r e4-brm-fit}
hmc$formula <- rating ~ (c1 + c2) * accuracy * group +
  ((c1 + c2) * accuracy | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$data <- dat4
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp4-a"
fit4.a <- do.call(brm, hmc)

hmc$formula <- rating ~ c1 * accuracy * group +
  (c1 * accuracy | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp4-b"
fit4.b <- do.call(brm, hmc)
```

Model comparison favored the quadratic model

```{r e4-waic}
waic4 <- waicm(fit4.a, fit4.b)
waic4$diffs
```

Model summary

```{r e4-brm-summary}
describe_posterior(
  fit4.a,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean",
  effects = "fixed", diagnostic = NULL, dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Trends averaging over accuracy

```{r}
emm <- emtrends(
  fit4.a,
  var = "c1", by = c("group"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -32.9, accuracy = NA)
)

bind_rows(
  describe_posterior(
    emm,
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  )
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)

emm <- emtrends(
  fit4.a,
  var = "c2", by = c("group"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -32.9, accuracy = NA)
)
bind_rows(
  describe_posterior(
    emm,
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  )
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```


Linear effect in each cell and differences therein

```{r e4-contrasts}
# Effect in each cell
emm <- emtrends(
  fit4.a,
  var = "c1", by = c("accuracy", "group"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -32.9)
)

gather_emmeans_draws(emm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = accuracy, values_from = .value) %>%
  mutate(`Error-Correct` = Error - Correct) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(group, Error, Correct, `Error-Correct`) %>%
  pivot_longer(Error:`Error-Correct`, names_to = "accuracy") %>%
  group_by(group, accuracy) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ describe_posterior(
      .$value,
      test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Experiment 4 linear trends") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Quadratic effect in each cell and differences therein

```{r e4-contrasts-q}

  fit4.a,
  var = "c2", by = c("accuracy", "group"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -32.9)
)

# Interactions
gather_emmeans_draws(emm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = accuracy, values_from = .value) %>%
  mutate(`Error-Correct` = Error - Correct) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(group, Error, Correct, `Error-Correct`) %>%
  pivot_longer(Error:`Error-Correct`, names_to = "accuracy") %>%
  group_by(group, accuracy) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ describe_posterior(
      .$value,
      test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Experiment 4 quadratic trends") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r e4-post-hoc}
)
describe_posterior(
  pairs(emm),
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(Parameter = str_sub(Parameter, 1, 28)) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Experiment 5

There were two missing values of accuracy.

```{r e5-data-load}
dat5 <- read_excel(
  "data/CuriosityPaperAllExperimentData.xlsx", 
  sheet = "Exp5"
) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  transmute(
    subject = factor(participant_public_id),
    accuracy = factor(
      lenient_correct, 
      levels = 0:1, 
      labels = c("Error", "Correct")
    ),
    confidence = as.numeric(conf1),
    curiosity = as.numeric(curious_post_feedback),
    item = factor(question)
  )

# Subject-mean centered confidence if needed
dat5 <- dat5 %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate(
    confidence_c = (confidence - mean(confidence, na.rm = TRUE)),
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create polynomial predictors
# in a way that are easier to understand
dat5 <- dat5 %>%
  poly_add_columns(confidence, degree = 2, prefix = "c", scale_width = 101)

tabyl(dat5, accuracy) %>% 
  kbl() %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
dat5 <- drop_na(dat5, accuracy)
```

### Summary

Summary of accuracy

```{r e5-accuracy}
dat5 %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(accuracy == "Correct", na.rm = TRUE),
    confidence = mean(confidence / 100, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    m_accuracy = mean(accuracy), sd_accuracy = sd(accuracy),
    m_confidence = mean(confidence), sd_confidence = sd(confidence)
  ) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Gamma correlation confidence - accuracy

```{r e5-gamma}
dat5 %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(
    resolution = GKgamma(table(accuracy, confidence))$gamma
  ) %>%
  summarise(m_resolution = mean(resolution), sd_resolution = sd(resolution)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Data figure

#### All participants

```{r e5-data-figure, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9, layout = "l-page",}
e5_p1
```

#### Summary

```{r e5-data-figure-2, fig.cap = "Means and 95%CIs for binned confidence. Empty points are individual participants' mean curiosity at each confidence bin."}
e5_p2 <- dat5 %>%
```

### ANOVA

Three bins

```{r e5-anova}
dat5_aov <- dat5 %>%
  drop_na(curiosity) %>% 
  mutate(conf_bin = cut(confidence, 3)) %>%
  group_by(subject, accuracy, conf_bin) %>%
  summarise(curiosity = mean(curiosity, na.rm = TRUE))

fit_aov <- aov_ez(
  data = dat5_aov,
  id = "subject",
  dv = "curiosity",
  within = c("conf_bin", "accuracy")
)
anova(fit_aov, intercept = TRUE) %>%
  kbl(
    digits = c(rep(1, 5), 4),
    caption = "Experiment 5 ANOVA"
  ) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Multilevel model

```{r e5-brm-fit}
hmc$formula <- curiosity ~ (c1 + c2) * accuracy +
  ((c1 + c2) * accuracy | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$data <- dat5
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp5-a"
fit5.a <- do.call(brm, hmc)

hmc$formula <- curiosity ~ c1 * accuracy +
  (c1 * accuracy | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp5-b"
fit5.b <- do.call(brm, hmc)
```

Model comparison favored the quadratic model

```{r e5-waic}
waic5 <- waicm(fit5.a, fit5.b)
waic5$diffs
```

Model summary

```{r e5-brm-summary}
describe_posterior(
  fit5.a,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean",
  effects = "fixed", diagnostic = NULL, dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Linear effect in each cell and differences therein

```{r e5-contrasts-linear}

  fit5.a,
  var = "c1", by = c("accuracy"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -32.9)
)
describe_posterior(
  emm,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Quadratic effect in each cell and differences therein

```{r e5-contrasts-quadratic}
# Effect in each cell

  fit5.a,
  var = "c2", by = c("accuracy"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -32.9)
)
describe_posterior(
  emm,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Post hoc test at high confidence

```{r e5-post-hoc}
ats <- distinct(dat5, confidence, c1, c2) %>%
  filter(confidence == 90)
emm <- emmeans(
  fit5.a,
  "accuracy",
  by = c("c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1, c2 = ats$c2)
)
describe_posterior(
  pairs(emm),
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(Parameter = str_sub(Parameter, 1, 15)) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Model figure

## Compare control and 5

```{r ec5-fit}
datc5 <- bind_rows(
  "Control" = datc, 
  "Experiment 5" = dat5,
  .id = "experiment"
) %>% 
  mutate(experiment = factor(experiment))
hmc$formula <- curiosity ~ (c1 + c2) * accuracy * experiment +
  ((c1 + c2) * accuracy | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$data <- datc5
hmc$file <- "models/brm-expc5-a"
fitc5.a <- do.call(brm, hmc)
```

Model summary

```{r ec5-brm-summary}
describe_posterior(
  fitc5.a,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean",
  effects = "fixed", diagnostic = NULL, dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Summary of model comparing control and Experiment 5") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Linear effect in each cell and differences therein

```{r ec5-contrasts}
# Effect in each cell
emm <- emtrends(
  fitc5.a,
  var = "c1", by = c("experiment", "accuracy"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -33)
)

bind_rows(
  "Slope" = describe_posterior(
    emm,
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  "Difference" = describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  .id = "Test"
) %>%
  mutate(Parameter = str_remove(Parameter, "0, -32.9, ")) %>% 
  mutate(Parameter = str_remove_all(Parameter, "0 -32.9 ")) %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Linear trends and contrasts") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)

emm <- emtrends(
  fitc5.a,
  var = "c2", by = c("experiment", "accuracy"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -33)
)

bind_rows(
  "Slope" = describe_posterior(
    emm,
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  "Difference" = describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  .id = "Test"
) %>%
  mutate(Parameter = str_remove(Parameter, "0, -32.9, ")) %>% 
  mutate(Parameter = str_remove_all(Parameter, "0 -32.9 ")) %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Quadratic terms and contrasts") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Post hoc test at different confidence levels

```{r ec5-post-hoc}
ats <- distinct(datc5, confidence, c1, c2) %>%
  arrange(c1) %>% 
  filter(confidence %in% c(10, 50, 90)) %>% 
  mutate(across(c1:c2, ~round(.)))
emm1 <- emmeans(
  fitc5.a,
  "experiment",
  by = c("accuracy", "c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[1], c2 = ats$c2[1])
)
emm2 <- emmeans(
  fitc5.a,
  "experiment",
  by = c("accuracy", "c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[2], c2 = ats$c2[2])
)
emm3 <- emmeans(
  fitc5.a,
  "experiment",
  by = c("accuracy", "c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[3], c2 = ats$c2[3])
)

bind_rows(
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm1, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm2, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm3, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  )
) %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Model figure

```{r}
ec5_tmp1 <- distinct(

  ) %>%
```

## Experiment 7

```{r e7-data-load}
dat7 <- read_excel(
  "data/CuriosityPaperAllExperimentData.xlsx", 
  sheet = "Exp7"
) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  transmute(
    subject = factor(participant_public_id),
    accuracy = factor(
      lenient_correct, 
      levels = 0:1, 
      labels = c("Error", "Correct")
    ),
    confidence = as.numeric(conf1),
    certainty = as.numeric(conf2),
    item = factor(question)
  )

# Create polynomial predictors
# in a way that are easier to understand
dat7 <- dat7 %>%
  poly_add_columns(confidence, degree = 2, prefix = "c", scale_width = 101)

tabyl(dat7, accuracy) %>%

dat7 <- drop_na(dat7, accuracy)
```

```{r e7-data-figure, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9, layout = "l-page",}
  scale_color_brewer(
```

### ANOVA

Three bins

```{r e7-anova}
dat7_aov <- dat7 %>%
  drop_na(certainty) %>% 
  mutate(conf_bin = cut(confidence, 3)) %>%
  group_by(subject, accuracy, conf_bin) %>%
  summarise(certainty = mean(certainty, na.rm = TRUE))

fit_aov <- aov_ez(
  data = dat7_aov,
  id = "subject",
  dv = "certainty",
  within = c("conf_bin", "accuracy")
)
anova(fit_aov, intercept = TRUE) %>%
  kbl(
    digits = c(rep(1, 5), 4),
    caption = "Experiment 7 ANOVA"
  ) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Multilevel model

```{r e7-brm-fit}
hmc$formula <- certainty ~ (c1 + c2) * accuracy +
  ((c1 + c2) * accuracy | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$data <- dat7
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp7-a"
fit7.a <- do.call(brm, hmc)

hmc$formula <- certainty ~ c1 * accuracy +
  (c1 * accuracy | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp7-b"
fit7.b <- do.call(brm, hmc)
```

Model comparison favored the quadratic model

```{r e7-waic}
waic7 <- waicm(fit7.a, fit7.b)
waic7$diffs
```

Model summary

```{r e7-brm-summary}
describe_posterior(
  fit7.a,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean",
  effects = "fixed", diagnostic = NULL, dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Experiment 6 model summary") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Intercepts

```{r}

) %>%

```

Linear effect in each cell and differences therein

## Compare control and 8

```{r ec8-fit}
datc8 <- bind_rows(
  "Control" = datc, 
  "Experiment 8" = dat8,
  .id = "experiment"
) %>% 
  mutate(experiment = factor(experiment))
hmc$formula <- curiosity ~ (c1 + c2) * accuracy * experiment +
  ((c1 + c2) * accuracy | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$data <- datc8
hmc$file <- "models/brm-expc8-a"
fitc8.a <- do.call(brm, hmc)
```

Model summary

```{r ec8-brm-summary}
describe_posterior(
  fitc8.a,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean",
  effects = "fixed", diagnostic = NULL, dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, caption = "Summary of model comparing control and Experiment 5") %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Linear effect in each cell and differences therein

```{r ec8-contrasts-linear}
# Effect in each cell
emm <- emtrends(
  fitc8.a,
  var = "c1", by = c("experiment", "accuracy"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -33)
)

bind_rows(
  "Slope" = describe_posterior(
    emm,
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  "Difference" = describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  .id = "Test"
) %>%
  mutate(Parameter = str_remove(Parameter, "0, -32.9, ")) %>% 
  mutate(Parameter = str_remove_all(Parameter, "0 -32.9 ")) %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Post hoc test at different confidence levels

```{r ec8-post-hoc}
ats <- distinct(datc8, confidence, c1, c2) %>%
  arrange(c1) %>% 
  filter(confidence %in% c(10, 50, 90)) %>% 
  mutate(across(c1:c2, ~round(.)))
emm1 <- emmeans(
  fitc8.a,
  "experiment",
  by = c("accuracy", "c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[1], c2 = ats$c2[1])
)
emm2 <- emmeans(
  fitc8.a,
  "experiment",
  by = c("accuracy", "c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[2], c2 = ats$c2[2])
)
emm3 <- emmeans(
  fitc8.a,
  "experiment",
  by = c("accuracy", "c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[3], c2 = ats$c2[3])
)

bind_rows(
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm1, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm2, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm3, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  )
) %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r e9-data-load}
) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  transmute(
    subject = factor(participant_public_id),
    accuracy = factor(
      lenient_correct, 
      levels = 0:1, 
      labels = c("Error", "Correct")
    ),
    confidence = as.numeric(confidence_rating),
    belief = as.numeric(sureof_given_answer_rating),
    item = factor(question),
    feedback_truth_value
  ) %>% 
  # Only false feedback
  filter(!feedback_truth_value) %>% 
  select(-feedback_truth_value)


# Create polynomial predictors
# in a way that are easier to understand
dat9 <- dat9 %>%
  poly_add_columns(confidence, degree = 2, prefix = "c", scale_width = 101)

tabyl(dat9, accuracy) %>% 
  kbl() %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
dat9 <- drop_na(dat9, accuracy)
```

### ANOVA

Three bins

```{r e9-anova}
dat9_aov <- dat9 %>%
  drop_na(belief) %>% 
  mutate(conf_bin = cut(confidence, 3)) %>%
  group_by(subject, accuracy, conf_bin) %>%
  summarise(belief = mean(belief, na.rm = TRUE))

fit_aov <- aov_ez(
  data = dat9_aov,
  id = "subject",
  dv = "belief",
  within = c("conf_bin", "accuracy")
)
anova(fit_aov, intercept = TRUE) %>%
  kbl(
    digits = c(rep(1, 5), 4),
    caption = "Experiment 9 ANOVA"
  ) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Multilevel model

```{r e9-brm-fit}
hmc$formula <- belief ~ (c1 + c2) * accuracy +
  ((c1 + c2) * accuracy | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$data <- dat9
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp9-a"
fit9.a <- do.call(brm, hmc)

hmc$formula <- belief ~ c1 * accuracy +
  (c1 * accuracy | subject) + 
  (1 | item)
hmc$file <- "models/brm-exp9-b"
fit9.b <- do.call(brm, hmc)
```

Model comparison favored neither model strongly

```{r e9-waic}
waic9 <- waicm(fit9.a, fit9.b)
waic9$diffs
```

Model summary

```{r e9-brm-summary}
describe_posterior(
  fit9.a,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean",
  effects = "fixed", diagnostic = NULL, dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Linear effect in each cell and differences therein

```{r e9-contrasts-linear}
# Effect in each cell
emm <- emtrends(
  fit9.a,
  var = "c1", by = c("accuracy"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -32.9)
)
describe_posterior(
  emm,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Quadratic effect in each cell and differences therein

```{r e9-contrasts-quadratic}
# Effect in each cell
emm <- emtrends(
  fit9.a,
  var = "c2", by = c("accuracy"),
  at = list(c1 = 0, c2 = -32.9)
)
describe_posterior(
  emm,
  test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```

Post hoc tests

```{r e9-post-hoc}
ats <- distinct(dat9, confidence, c1, c2) %>%
  arrange(c1) %>% 
  filter(confidence %in% c(10, 50, 90)) %>% 
  mutate(across(c1:c2, ~round(.)))

emm1 <- emmeans(
  fit9.a,
  "accuracy",
  by = c("c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[1], c2 = ats$c2[1])
)
emm2 <- emmeans(
  fit9.a,
  "accuracy",
  by = c("c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[2], c2 = ats$c2[2])
)
emm3 <- emmeans(
  fit9.a,
  "accuracy",
  by = c("c1", "c2"),
  at = list(c1 = ats$c1[3], c2 = ats$c2[3])
)

bind_rows(
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm1, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm2, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  ),
  describe_posterior(
    pairs(emm3, reverse = TRUE),
    test = "pd", ci = 0.95, centrality = "mean", dispersion = TRUE
  )
) %>% 
  mutate(pd = percent(pd, .01)) %>%
  kbl(digits = 2) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "Arial", full_width = FALSE)
```
